name: Rosewater Pleated Gown
fabric: Pleated chiffon with a soft satin lining
description: A floor length gown in dusty rose, cut with fine pleats that move as you walk. The draped back and flowing skirt make it a gentle choice for evenings and celebrations.

name: Mauve Wrap Midi Dress
fabric: Matte crepe with a smooth drape
description: A midi dress in muted mauve with a soft boat neckline and a skirt that falls in clean folds. Easy to wear from a lunch out to an evening gathering.

name: Champagne Satin Slip Dress
description: A modest dress in warm champagne satin that catches the light softly. The high neckline and long sleeves give full, graceful coverage, and the fluid skirt falls to full length.

name: Ivory Summer Dress
description: A light ivory dress made for warm days, with a relaxed bodice and a skirt that sways as you move. Simple, fresh and easy to style.

name: Blush Embroidered Kurti
description: A blush pink kurti with fine floral embroidery across the chest, finished with three quarter sleeves. A graceful everyday piece that pairs with white trousers or jeans.

name: Rose Pink Kurti
description: A rose pink kurti with delicate embroidery along the neckline and cuffs. Light, breathable and made for daily wear through the warmer months.

name: Mehreen Printed Kurta
description: A printed kurta in deep rose tones with a traditional motif pattern. The relaxed fit and soft lawn fabric keep it comfortable all day.

name: Slate Print Kurta Set
description: A kurta set in slate blue with a fine printed pattern, worn with a matching dupatta. A complete outfit that needs nothing added.

name: Sand Linen Co-ord Set
description: A two piece co-ord set in warm sand, with a relaxed shirt and wide leg trousers. Worn together for an easy put together look, or mixed with pieces you already own.

name: Ivory Linen Shirt Set
fabric: Linen blend with a soft finish
description: An ivory linen shirt set with a buttoned shirt worn long and untied, its hem falling to the waist, with matching trousers. Clean lines and a fabric that keeps its shape through the day.

name: Mint Summer Shorts Set
fabric: Cotton twill and a soft knit top
description: A fresh summer pairing of a mint top with white drawstring shorts. Made for holidays, slow weekends and warm evenings.

name: Everyday Tee and Denim Look
description: The everyday pairing done well: a clean white tee with light wash denim. Simple pieces, chosen carefully, that go with everything.
